package.name: kims
package.description: KIMS: Kinematics-Constrained MPPI Smoothing for UWB-IMU 6-DoF Pose Estimation. UWB-IMU fixed-lag smoother. Offline tools (KIMS, matched LM, SW-PGO, particle filter) that read CSV and build without ROS, and the online ROS node kims_online for IMU and Nooploop LinkTrack topics or bags.
